abs_engine_braking.definition: Slowing the car with the engine and the gearbox instead of with the brake pedal.
abs_engine_braking.example: On the long descent he used engine braking and the brakes stayed cool.

dual_impulse.definition: A sudden push to act before you have thought it through.
dual_impulse.example: The impulse to reply at once was stronger than the answer.

gd_darvo.definition: The name of the pattern of three moves: deny, attack, and reverse victim and offender.
gd_darvo.example: The pattern was DARVO: deny, attack, and reverse victim and offender.

intelill_validity.definition: The quality of a test that asks whether it measures what it claims to measure.
intelill_validity.example: The test was reliable but not valid for the work we do.
